note: First version (decision screen-sizes): a list beside its detail on a wide window

component.doc: Two panes for a wide window: its first child (a list) at list_width on the left and its second (the detail) filling the rest; on a narrower window (size_class compact or medium) the first child alone. Each pane brings its own core://Scroll. Rows usually pick what the detail shows on a wide window (action.local.set on local://<key>#selected, the detail showing the matching core://Layout with show_when and equals) and push it on a narrow one (each row's two intents in core://Conditional on ${local://device#size_class}).

params.name: list_width
params.doc: The list pane's width in points.
